description: The DC office of Representative Marilyn Strickland (WA-10) is currently accepting applicants for a paid Fall Legislative Internship with a start date of Monday, August 24, 2026, until December 2026, with the potential to extend. Legislative Interns assist the legislative staff by preparing briefing notes and memos, researching legislation, tracking legislative activity, providing mail program support, answering phones, inputting casework inquiries, attending hearings, and advancing the Congresswoman's legislative agenda. Ideal candidates are diligent, detail-oriented, and can excel in a fast-paced environment. Applicants should possess strong written and verbal communication skills, an eye for and ability to create engaging digital content, and a good sense of humor. Ties to Washington State are preferred but not required. Applicants are encouraged to include any previous customer service experience (retail, food service, hospitality, etc.) on their resumes. The deadline for applications is Thursday, August 6, 2026, at 5 PM ET, but applicants are encouraged to submit their applications early. Applications that are incomplete or submitted after the deadline will not be considered. Please no unsolicited phone calls or drop-ins.
responsibilities: Preparing briefing notes and memos
Researching legislation
Tracking legislative activity
Providing mail program support
Answering phones
Inputting casework inquiries
Attending hearings
Advancing the Congresswoman's legislative agenda
qualifications: Diligent and detail-oriented
Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Eye for and ability to create engaging digital content
Good sense of humor
Ties to Washington State preferred but not required
Previous customer service experience (retail, food service, hospitality, etc.) encouraged
how_to_apply: Send a resume, cover letter, and a one-page writing sample in a single PDF document to WA10resumes@gmail.com with "DC Fall Legislative Internship-[LAST NAME]" in the subject line. Indicate in the cover letter which internship you are applying for and your dates of availability. The deadline for applications is Thursday, August 6, 2026, at 5 PM ET.
equal_opportunity: This office is an Equal Employment Opportunity Office and does not discriminate in employment based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, military service, or other non-merit factors. Individuals from underrepresented communities are encouraged to apply.

description: The Office of Congressman Salud Carbajal (CA-24) is seeking a highly motivated and creative Digital/Press Intern to assist with a fast-paced communications operation based in his Washington, D.C. office for the Fall 2026 term (August - December). The Digital/Press Intern will help build out the Congressman's digital and social media footprint, with heavy emphasis on creating engaging social media content and graphics. The intern will work closely with the Communications Director, Digital/Creative Assistant, Legislative Aide/Correspondent, and Scheduler. The internship will run from August to December. The hours are roughly 32 hours a week and are flexible to accommodate schedules, but generally run 9 AM to 6 PM ET when Congress is in session and 9 AM to 5 PM ET when Congress is out of session. This position is in-person. This is a full-time, limited term position and offers a $1,500 monthly stipend from the office of Congressman Carbajal unless the intern is already receiving credit/stipend through a third party. Deadline to apply is Friday, July 31, 2026.
responsibilities: Compiling daily press clips
Creating engaging graphics and editing photos
Assisting the Digital/Creative Assistant with social media content, website content and digital newsletters
Clipping, editing, and captioning videos
Assisting with press releases, op-eds, advisories, and other written materials
Creating and maintaining press lists
Compiling regular comms reports on press and social media results
Assisting the Legislative Aide/Correspondent and Scheduler with administrative tasks (e.g. answering phone calls, greeting visitors, etc.)
Assisting with legislative tasks (e.g. batching incoming messages on Fireside, drafting constituent letters, writing cosponsor recommendations, etc.)
qualifications: Strong writing, editing, and social media skills
Basic familiarity with graphic design/video editing software
Experience in a press or digital media role (including internships) preferred but not required
Strong social media and graphic design skills
Past experience with Canva, Photoshop, and other digital/graphic/video design platforms is a major plus
California or Central Coast ties are a plus
Spanish literacy is a plus
how_to_apply: Email a resume, cover letter, writing sample, two digital samples, and dates/hours of availability to Tommy.Vo@mail.house.gov with the subject line "First Name Last Name – Digital Intern." No phone calls or walk-ins. Deadline to apply is Friday, July 31, 2026. Candidates are encouraged to submit materials early.
equal_opportunity: This office is an equal opportunity employer and encourages candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply.
